reason: The plugin is primarily a memory/context tool for DSH agents, as it defines OCR1-style memory tools to store, retrieve, update, list, forget, and inspect memory entries, with a rendering pipeline that turns text into image-based segments and uses age-based resolution/active-recall behavior. The manifest and README explicitly expose this as a DeepSeek-OCR memory system, and configuration is centered on OCR endpoints, rendering paths, and memory store settings, indicating user-facing memory management rather than general coding, UI, or search utilities.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 提供基于 OCR 渲染记忆的管理工具，支持文本记忆存储、检索、更新、删除，并可查看记忆状态与指标。
summaries.en: This plugin provides DSH memory-management tools using OCR-rendered memory entries, including storing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and checking memory status and metrics.

capabilities: local file-backed memory storage and metadata files
rendering pipeline that generates and caches images for memory entries
embedding-based retrieval and fallback text matching for recall
